author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be an attempt by the Government to start easing in the talks of controlling the very algorithm that gives you content on this platform. This is being talked about because old media and propaganda is losing its power as people finally have a voice themselves. How is this going to play out? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Now They Want To Censor YouTube...
